pr_title: Fixed bug with text going under scrollbar
pr_body:
Fixes #57881
I fixed the issue with the text going under the scroll bar in `ItemList`. I changed the default OverrunBehavior to add ellipsis instead of doing nothing.
![working preview of itemlist 2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/65504787/155409126-34ba22b6-f066-481b-9914-d5326bb4542a.gif)
pr_comments: I'm not sure how to get rid of the other commits. Help would be appreciated. @bruvzg

- Reset it to the first commit `git reset --hard 1d0298c`.
- Then rebase `git pull --rebase upstream master` (assuming main Godot repo remote is named `upstream`).
- Run `-doctool`.
- Stage the changes `git add <files>`, and amend the commit `git commit --amend`
- Force push it.

See https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/community/contributing/pr_workflow.html for more info.
Thank you so much. It was the `git push --force` that I wasn't doing. Anyways, I updated the class reference.
Thanks! And congrats for your first merged Godot contribution :tada:

comments:
It looks like the issue is in the `ItemList`.
Here is how it works in Godot 3.4:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25117425/153687523-1fbf7164-a269-4732-a26e-44625872b060.mp4

And Godot 4:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25117425/153687535-4cd4cf5b-3b9b-4513-95c1-a4b5a9bf5a4f.mp4

In Godot 4 it works properly only if the width of the item list is above some value, otherwise it just ignores the scrollbar

I created a pull request #58073 which fixes the issue with `ItemList`. 

The FileSystem tab uses `tree.cpp` which doesn't truncate the text properly when the horizontal scrollbar is visible. The Scene tab does it correctly when the visibility buttons are there.
![nonworking preview of tree](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/65504787/153780217-17177b2b-b8d5-49df-8901-026b21ae8325.gif)
.
